families.page_title: Naphthalene: health effects, incident management and toxicology
evidence_points: The official UKHSA page provides information on naphthalene for use when responding to chemical incidents.
The page is published by the UK Health Security Agency on GOV.UK.
The publication was first published on 1 July 2014.
The GOV.UK record shows a latest update of 12 December 2024.
The publication provides general information, toxicological overview and incident management material.
The linked material supports substance-specific assessment of health effects, exposure and incident response for naphthalene.
Naphthalene is also called naphthene or naphthalin.
The official page was live-opened successfully on 31 July 2026 and retained the title “Naphthalene: health effects, incident management and toxicology”.
